title: The Empty House
summary: Josh and Chuck's annual Halloween episode, in which they read aloud "The Empty House," a early twentieth-century horror short story by Algernon Blackwood. The story follows Shorthouse and his elderly aunt Julia, who enter a reputedly haunted house in a town square (number thirteen) that they have keys to. They search the empty house, hear doors closing, see a apparition of a woman in the scullery and an angry man's face, and endure the candle being crushed out. Upstairs, sounds of feet lead to a chase and a crash, and they flee the house. The hosts briefly recap the plot, mention last year's horror fiction contest and winner Brett S. Arnold's story "Signed Forever and Ever," and sign off wishing listeners a happy Halloween.

segments.title: Halloween tradition and horror contest recap
segments.summary: Hosts introduce the Halloween tradition of reading a scary story, recap last year's horror fiction contest and the winning story Signed Forever and Ever by Brett S. Arnold, and announce this year's reading by Algernon Blackwood.

segments.title: The Empty House, part one: arrival at the haunted house
segments.summary: Reading of the opening of The Empty House: the narrator describes a haunted house in a square that looks like its neighbors. Shorthouse visits his aunt Julia, who has keys to the house and wants to investigate it, and she persuades him to come along. They enter the house at number thirteen just before midnight.

segments.title: The Empty House, part two: searching the house
segments.summary: The pair search the empty house by candlelight, descending to the kitchen and scullery, where Aunt Julia screams at the sight of a woman's apparition before the candle goes out. A chase-like sound and a doors-closing incident are also described.

segments.title: The Empty House, part three: doors closing and a menacing face
segments.summary: In the front drawing room, the folding doors are found closed though no wind is present. Shorthouse sees an angry man's face in the moment before the candle is extinguished.

segments.title: The Empty House, part four: candle crushed and the top floor
segments.summary: The candle is found crushed flat rather than blown out. They search the servants' rooms on the top floor and then settle in a small third-floor room to wait until midnight.

segments.title: The Empty House, part five: sounds upstairs and the aunt's transformed face
segments.summary: While waiting, they hear footsteps upstairs. Aunt Julia's face takes on a youthful, vacant look from terror, then returns to normal. Shorthouse gives her brandy and they decide to go upstairs to confront the noise.

segments.title: The Empty House, part six: the chase and escape, plus sign-off
segments.summary: A crash and a scream come from the servants' corridor, then two unseen figures race down the staircase past them. After a thud below, the pair flee the house into the moonlight. The hosts comment on the ending and wish listeners a happy Halloween.
